questions.stem: A dermatologist is explaining to a patient the importance of various skin structures in maintaining the skin's barrier function. She mentions a specific part of skin cells that contributes to the waterproof barrier, which prevents water loss and the entry of pathogens. Which component of the skin cells is most directly responsible for this critical barrier function?
